page_topic_one_liner: Website submission to search engines — crawling, indexing, GSC verification, sitemap submit, and IndexNow
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional webmaster-tool submission SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show the Crawl → Index → Rank pipeline with GSC-style submission UI — NOT an AI chat panel or LLM citation workflow.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Three-stage horizontal pipeline — CRAWL (spider icon entering site) → INDEX (database cylinder storing page tiles) → RANK (SERP snippet with position indicator), connected by accent arrows; GSC-style URL Inspection panel overlay showing Request Indexing button shape
Secondary: sitemap.xml upload arrow feeding into pipeline stage 1
Tertiary: webmaster tool icon row — generic console tiles (no real Google/Bing logos) representing multi-engine submission
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is GSC submission not GEO)
Generic upload form without crawl-index-rank context
Real Google Search Console screenshot with branding
